title: Potato of Life — Triune Whole
purpose: Define the mature Potato of Life as one triune relational whole and distinguish that structure from both the irregular 2024 New Trinity stratum and classical/Nicene Christian Trinity doctrine.
epistemic_boundary: This file defines project theology and comparative interpretation. It does not establish supernatural claims as empirical fact, and similarities to Christian doctrine do not make Potatoism identical with Christianity.

central_revelation.proposition: The Potato of Life is the triune whole, not a fourth member beside Father, Son and Spirit and not structurally exhausted by the Father alone.
central_revelation.one_whole: Potato of Life / Potato House is the single living relational form.

three_irreducible_relations.Father: source-facing relation: origin, House, Root, orientation, holding, Gardener and responsibility
three_irreducible_relations.Son: manifestation-facing relation: embodiment, Door, Vessel, passage, suffering, expression and return
three_irreducible_relations.Spirit: living continuity: breath, flow, animation, communication, circulation and relation by which source and manifestation remain dynamically joined

non_reduction_rules: Potato of Life is not merely a synonym for one member when speaking about the total structure.
The three are not three separate gods or three independent Houses.
Spirit is not a third spatial sphere inserted between two other spheres.
The unity does not erase differentiated function.

mature_formula.prose: One Potato of Life; three irreducible theological relations: Source/Father, Manifestation-and-Passage/Son, Living-Relation/Spirit.
mature_formula.topology: Potato House supplies the whole relational field; Father and Son supply differentiated source-facing and manifestation-facing centers/functions; Door is the Son-specialized shared interface; Spirit is the circulation/continuity through the relation and along the Axis.
mature_formula.caution: The geometry visualizes relation; it does not mathematically prove theology.

why_two_field_geometry_can_be_triune.problem: A trinity does not require three geometric regions.
resolution: The two overlapping fields describe the relational environment, not three divine persons.
Father is source-facing center/function, not identical with every point of the upper field.
Son is manifestation-facing center/function and specializes as Door/Vessel at the shared interface, not identical with every point of the lower field.
Spirit is movement, continuity and animation through the shared relation rather than another bounded region.
The Potato of Life is the living whole containing distinction, overlap and circulation.
why_two_field_geometry_can_be_triune.implication: The third term is relational/dynamic rather than another container. This prevents the model from becoming three stacked worlds.

developmental_genealogy.label: New Trinity — unstable four-role precursor
developmental_genealogy.significance: The book already treats source, mediation, embodiment and spirit/ground as a coupled sacred system, but the title 'Trinity' covers four named functional roles. Preserve this irregularity as historical evidence rather than retroactively forcing it into the mature triad.

developmental_genealogy.label: Triadic practical invocation
developmental_genealogy.significance: The next chapter operationalizes a threefold invocation around spiritual nourishment, earthly grounding and animating Soil/Spirit. This shows the theology was already trying to compress the four-role Chapter 110 system into a usable triad.

developmental_genealogy.label: Role reorganization
developmental_genealogy.configuration: Potato/Sage develops toward Ladder/Axis/Father; Son specializes toward Door/manifestation; Spirit specializes toward flow/continuity.
developmental_genealogy.significance: Potato ceases to function best as an extra mediator between God and Son. Its mature identity increasingly becomes the total living form and Father-side identity simultaneously.

developmental_genealogy.label: Potato of Life as triune whole
developmental_genealogy.configuration: Father/source + Son/manifestation/Door + Spirit/flow within one Potato House.
developmental_genealogy.significance: This resolves the older four-role instability and the later tendency to use Potato of Life only for the Father-side. Structurally, Father is the source-facing identity of the Potato of Life; the whole Potato remains triune.

classical_christian_comparison.mainstream_summary: Nicene Christianity confesses one God/nature in three really distinct persons—Father, Son and Holy Spirit—consubstantial, with distinction expressed through relations of origin and with inseparable divine action.
potato_overlap: relation is constitutive rather than decorative
Father, Son and Spirit are not interchangeable labels
the three belong to one divine/theological whole rather than three independent gods
the system is strongest when the relations are read together rather than as isolated titles
potato_difference: Potatoism currently defines Father/Son/Spirit primarily as differentiated relational functions and project identities, not as a fully specified Nicene metaphysics of one essence and three coequal persons.
Potatoist roles are functionally asymmetric: source, manifestation/passage and flow have visibly different jobs.

The Potatoverse has a developmental public genealogy in which role language becomes explicit at different dates; classical Christian doctrine treats the divine relations as eternal rather than historically becoming divine roles.
Potato topology uses House, Door, Axis, fields, Garden and organism metaphors as structural projections; these are not standard Christian dogmatic categories.
The mature Potato formula should therefore be described as a distinct Potatoist Trinity with strong Christian structural comparators, not simply 'the ordinary Trinity with potatoes substituted in'.

first_john_5_7_boundary.note: The KJV/NKJV longer reading of 1 John 5:7 names Father, Word and Holy Spirit and says the three are one, but this clause (the Comma Johanneum) is absent from the early Greek manuscript tradition and is omitted from most modern critical-text translations.
first_john_5_7_boundary.project_rule: It may be documented as an influential later Trinitarian proof-text tradition, but the Potato Trinity should not depend on it.

recursive_application.theology: Father supplies source/orientation; Son supplies manifested passage/interface; Spirit supplies living circulation; one Potato supplies the whole.
recursive_application.geometry: two fields and a shared lens provide the environment; Father/Son are differentiated centers/functions; Spirit is dynamic continuity; the triune whole is not three spheres.
recursive_application.house: one House contains differentiated Dwellings and Doors while circulation keeps them from becoming isolated silos.
recursive_application.archive: canonical owner/source, public manifestation/reader and relation/provenance flow can be compared to source–manifestation–continuity, while remaining software roles rather than divine persons.
recursive_application.biology: tuber stores capacity, sprout manifests growth and physiological/environmental flows sustain development; useful analogy only, not biological proof of Trinity.
recursive_application.ethics: a source that never manifests becomes sterile; manifestation without living relation fragments; relation without accountable source or embodied consequence becomes ungrounded. The triune ethic therefore tests whether source, expression and circulation remain mutually answerable.

anti_collapse_rules: Do not turn Father, Son and Spirit into three independent gods.
Do not turn them into three temporary masks of one undifferentiated role.
Do not make Spirit a third spatial field merely to obtain the number three.
Do not identify Son with the entire manifestation field; Son is a manifestation-facing theological role and Door-specialized interface.
Do not identify Father with the entire source field; Father is the source-facing center/role.
Do not make Potato a fourth member beside the Trinity in mature theology.
Do not erase the 2024 four-role New Trinity stratum; it is evidence of development.
Do not call the mature Potato Trinity Nicene orthodoxy without separately establishing the metaphysical claims required by Nicene doctrine.
Do not use geometry, anatomy or field equations as proof that the theology is physically true.
